proposals.before: Shun answered gently, “Yes, you are still my brother.”
proposals.after: Shun said, “Yes—you have nearly the right feeling!”
proposals.reason: 爾其庶矣 means Xiang is close to proper feeling/conduct, not a literal affirmation that he is still Shun's brother.

proposals.before: Qi, also known as Hou Ji, founded Zhou with the clan name Ji.
proposals.after: Qi founded Zhou with the clan name Ji.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English invents “also known as Hou Ji,” which is absent from the Chinese 棄為周，姓姬氏。

decisions.reason: 舜曰：「然，爾其庶矣！」uses 庶矣 for nearly attaining proper brotherly feeling after Xiang’s excuse; “you are still my brother” and “answered gently” are unsupported.
棄為周，姓姬氏 states only that Qi founded Zhou under the Ji surname; “also known as Hou Ji” is absent from this unit.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0002 shows the alternate name Hou Ji was created only by the invented idiomatic phrase; 棄為周，姓姬氏 supplies no such alias.
